none: PAS NLM-59BE15: Roman Coin: siliqua of Theodosius I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN THEODO(SIV)S PF AVG ; R/ VIR(TVS RO)MANORVM

Silver. Coin. Siliqua of Theodosius I (379-395), Reece period 20-21. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right, upper face clipped out. Obverse inscription: DN THEODO(SIV)S PF AVG. Reverse description: Roma seated left holding Victory and spear. Reverse inscription: VIR(TVS RO)MANORVM. In exergue: TRPS, for Trier mint, second officina. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.8mm, Weight: 1.42gms, die axis: 12
